hints.title: Strict Maximum Range
hints.text: For each index i, we seek the maximal subarray containing i where nums[i] is strictly greater than all other elements.

hints.title: Left and Right Greater Elements
hints.text: Find the nearest index to the left with a value strictly greater than nums[i], and the nearest index to the right with a value strictly greater than nums[i].

hints.title: Monotonic Stack Span Calculation
hints.text: Using two monotonic stack passes, compute left[i] and right[i]. The maximal valid range length is right[i] - left[i] - 1.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Two-pass monotonic stack finding left and right strictly greater elements.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Expanding outwards from each index takes O(n^2) worst-case time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary space for stack and boundary arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use monotonic stacks to compute both boundaries in linear time.
